title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: earthworks
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Bulk earthworks for the bowl and pitch
swms.task: Cut and fill the stadium bowl and pitch with dozers, graders, excavators and rollers, with trucks carting spoil off site.

facts.excavationPlan: Earthworks follow the geotechnical design G-201 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with batters no steeper than 1 in 2, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-03.
facts.spoilPlan: Spoil is classified as clean fill (tested by the geotechnical engineer, report G-201-T) and taken to the council-licensed fill site at Swanbank, with the waste records the state environment regulator requires. Stockpiles are kept only in the laydown area the principal contractor allows, and covered with tarps when dry and windy.

rules.phrase: Manage the risks of plant overturning
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 214, s 215
rules.quote: (a) the plant overturning; (b) things falling on the operator of the plant; (c) the operator being ejected from the plant; (d) the plant colliding with any person or thing
